description: Premium portrait rendering with flattering skin, refined tonal depth, natural color, excellent subject separation, and polished commercial quality.
editing_goals: Produce a polished premium portrait with immediate visual impact while maintaining complete realism.
Render healthy, believable skin tones under all lighting conditions.
Create confident tonal depth with clean highlights, gentle shadows, and natural contrast.
Increase subject prominence through tonal separation rather than excessive local contrast.
Preserve fine facial detail including eyes, eyelashes, eyebrows, lips, hair, and clothing texture.
Maintain realistic environmental color for travel and lifestyle portraits.
cautions: Never create plastic or overly smoothed skin.
Avoid halos around hair, hats, shoulders, or facial features.
Avoid excessive Texture, Clarity, or Dehaze on faces.
Avoid oversaturated skin or excessive warmth.
Avoid crushed blacks that hide hair or clothing detail.
Do not remove natural skin texture.
Do not interpret natural as flat or unfinished.

guidance: Correct only obvious accidental camera roll.
Never infer level from shoulders, facial asymmetry, body posture, or head tilt.
Use architectural or environmental references when available.
